title: No mystery here — 'Bigfoot' brings lottery player $100K in online game Wednesday
excerpt: A lucky Massachusetts lottery player struck it big in an online game set deep in the woods, complete with camping vibes, a mythical creature and a shot at a major jackpot.
content:
A Massachusetts State Lottery player won more than $100,000 on Wednesday while playing the lottery online.

The prize, worth $109,989, was won from the game "Bigfoot Bucks." The game features a wilderness-themed design with camping imagery, nighttime forest scenes and a mysterious creature said to roam the woods.

Players win by revealing clusters of three or more matching symbols. A Bigfoot Wild symbol can substitute for other symbols and increase the game's multiplier meter by 1X or 2X. Finding three bonus symbols unlocks a bonus wheel that offers chances at instant prizes, free plays or the "Wild Jackpot."

The Wild Jackpot is pending as of Thursday, according to the state lottery website.

Overall, at least 909 prizes worth $600 or more were won or claimed in Massachusetts on Thursday, including 7 in Springfield, 17 in Worcester and 48 in Boston.

The Massachusetts State Lottery releases a full list of winning tickets every day. The list only includes winning tickets worth more than $600.

The largest lottery prize claimed in Massachusetts so far this year was worth $29.71 million. It was from a Megabucks ticket sold at King Mart in Holyoke.
